# Git Workflow — Generated Artifacts

All generated by `/git:setup-github` (`bash bin/app git workflow-setup --apply`) from `.github/workflow.env`.

Header in every generated file:
```
# GENERATED — do not edit manually. Source: bin/modules/git/templates/<file>.sh via workflow-setup
```

**Never edit generated files directly.** Change `workflow.env` and re-run `/git:setup-github`.

## Single-repo

```
.github/
  branch-protection.yaml
  workflows/
    status-checks.yml
    release-pipeline-<RELEASE_BRANCH>.yml
    post-release-<RELEASE_BRANCH>.yml
    release-pipeline-<legacy>.yml          (one per LEGACY_BRANCHES, no post-release)
release-please-config.json
```

## Monorepo

```
.github/
  branch-protection.yaml
  workflows/
    status-checks.yml
    merge-split-repo-<RELEASE_BRANCH>.yml
    merge-split-repo-<legacy>.yml          (one per LEGACY_BRANCHES)

packages/<name>/
  .github/
    branch-protection.yaml
    workflows/
      release-pipeline.yml
      sync-to-monorepo.yml
      release-publish.yml                  (node only)
  release-please-config.json
```

## Template Sources

| Generated file | Template source |
|---|---|
| `status-checks.yml`, `release-pipeline-*.yml`, `post-release-*.yml` | `bin/modules/git/templates/workflow-callers.sh` |
| `merge-split-repo-*.yml`, `sync-to-monorepo.yml`, `release-publish.yml` | `bin/modules/git/templates/workflow-callers.sh` |
| `branch-protection.yaml` | `bin/modules/git/templates/branch-protection.sh` |
| `release-please-config.json` | `bin/modules/git/templates/release-please.sh` |
